[package]
name = "clap"
version = "4.3.22"
description = "A simple to use, efficient, and full-featured Command Line Argument Parser"
repository = "https://github.com/clap-rs/clap"
categories = ["command-line-interface"]
keywords = [
  "argument",
  "cli",
  "arg",
  "parser",
  "parse"
]
license.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
include.workspace = true

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["unstable-doc"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs", "--generate-link-to-definition"]
cargo-args = ["-Zunstable-options", "-Zrustdoc-scrape-examples"]

[package.metadata.playground]
features = ["unstable-doc"]

[package.metadata.release]
shared-version = true
tag-name = "v{{version}}"
pre-release-replacements = [
  {file="CHANGELOG.md", search="Unreleased", replace="{{version}}", min=1},
  {file="CHANGELOG.md", search="\\.\\.\\.HEAD", replace="...{{tag_name}}", exactly=1},
  {file="CHANGELOG.md", search="ReleaseDate", replace="{{date}}", min=1},
  {file="CHANGELOG.md", search="<!-- next-header -->", replace="<!-- next-header -->\n## [Unreleased] - ReleaseDate\n", exactly=1},
  {file="CHANGELOG.md", search="<!-- next-url -->", replace="<!-- next-url -->\n[Unreleased]: https://github.com/clap-rs/clap/compare/{{tag_name}}...HEAD", exactly=1},
  {file="CITATION.cff", search="^date-released: ....-..-..", replace="date-released: {{date}}"},
  {file="CITATION.cff", search="^version: .+\\..+\\..+", replace="version: {{version}}"},
]

[features]
default = [
  "std",
  "color",
  "help",
  "usage",
  "error-context",
  "suggestions",
]
debug = ["clap_builder/debug", "clap_derive?/debug"] # Enables debug messages
unstable-doc = ["clap_builder/unstable-doc", "derive"] # for docs.rs

# Used in default
std = ["clap_builder/std"] # support for no_std in a backwards-compatible way
color = ["clap_builder/color"]
help = ["clap_builder/help"]
usage = ["clap_builder/usage"]
error-context = ["clap_builder/error-context"]
suggestions = ["clap_builder/suggestions"]

# Optional
deprecated = ["clap_builder/deprecated", "clap_derive?/deprecated"] # Guided experience to prepare for next breaking release (at different stages of development, this may become default)
derive = ["dep:clap_derive", "dep:once_cell"]
cargo = ["clap_builder/cargo"] # Disable if you're not using Cargo, enables Cargo-env-var-dependent macros
wrap_help = ["clap_builder/wrap_help"]
env = ["clap_builder/env"] # Use environment variables during arg parsing
unicode = ["clap_builder/unicode"]  # Support for unicode characters in arguments and help messages
string = ["clap_builder/string"]  # Allow runtime generated strings

# In-work features
unstable-v5 = ["clap_builder/unstable-v5", "clap_derive?/unstable-v5", "deprecated"]
unstable-styles = ["clap_builder/unstable-styles"]

[lib]
bench = false

[dependencies]
clap_builder = { path = "./clap_builder", version = "=4.3.22", default-features = false }
clap_derive = { path = "./clap_derive", version = "=4.3.12", optional = true }
once_cell = { version = "1.12.0", optional = true }

[dev-dependencies]
trybuild = "1.0.82"
rustversion = "1.0.14"
# Cutting out `filesystem` feature
trycmd = { version = "0.14.16", default-features = false, features = ["color-auto", "diff", "examples"] }
humantime = "2.1.0"
snapbox = "0.4.11"
shlex = "1.1.0"

limitations: Explicit free-function paths, monomorphic inherent source candidates and bare generic-struct paths to unique concrete-specialization source candidates. Lifetime-only struct/enum owners additionally allow bare paths to unique receiver-free inherent declarations when unbounded impl lifetime names map one-to-one to owner arguments; unsupported siblings and enum variant names block selection. Specializations require named type arguments and no impl generics/where clause; competing unsupported inherent declarations block the candidate. Closure inputs are typed only from a local free-function fn/impl Fn/generic Fn bound plus call-argument shapes; closures passed to method calls, iterator adapters or external APIs remain unknown, and every other type/argument inference, visibility checking, Self/type-alias resolution, explicit generic call arguments, mixed lifetime/type parameters, concrete or bounded lifetime specializations, const/bounded/defaulted generic owners, receiver types beyond explicit parameters, adjacent-before-let bindings and trait objects, general macro expansion, build-script execution or external dependency source loading.

Cargo metadata reads captured manifests with zero-byte source inventory stubs, offline/no-deps/locked; the syntax parser reads captured source text only. Active cfg derives from rustc target cfg plus the declared local feature profile; custom build-script cfg stays unknown.

Call inventory covers parsed function/method bodies plus trait default method bodies, each once per source declaration; declarations without a body add no calls and calls depending on the concrete Self remain unresolved. A local macro_rules! invocation is traversed as its source argument expression only when the binding actually visible at the callsite (including a preceding block-local definition) is defined exactly once across the selected crates, is textually visible without an import or glob that could bind the same name, and every rule matches a single $x:expr used exactly once outside repetition and nested macro arguments under the active cfg; such calls carry macroEvidence. A zero-argument local macro used as the whole body of an impl may supply generated methods, subject to the combined cfg on the outer impl, macro invocation, generated methods and their bodies; removed calls are omitted and unknown conditions do not establish targets. Calls in these templates carry macroTemplate with the captured macro-name definition and distinct invocation/outer-impl origins, retaining printable original self types and optional trait paths. One physical call represents all contributing expansions; directCaller uses a template-qualified macro-generated-method identity, or local-function for a nested function. Divergent targets remain unresolved with rust-context-dependent, retaining provenance but no per-expansion targets. Other macros stay opaque records. Missing/excluded modules, conditional scopes and unsupported local items limit target/caller completeness.

build.profile: all local workspace targets; defaults and local path feature propagation; not a Cargo build/resolve graph

[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
  "clap_bench",
  "clap_builder",
  "clap_derive",
  "clap_lex",
  "clap_complete",
  "clap_complete_fig",
  "clap_complete_nushell",
  "clap_mangen",
]

[workspace.package]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.64.0"  # MSRV
include = [
  "build.rs",
  "src/**/*",
  "Cargo.toml",
  "LICENSE*",
  "README.md",
  "benches/**/*",
  "examples/**/*"
]

[package]
name = "clap"
version = "4.3.22"
description = "A simple to use, efficient, and full-featured Command Line Argument Parser"
repository = "https://github.com/clap-rs/clap"
categories = ["command-line-interface"]
keywords = [
  "argument",
  "cli",
  "arg",
  "parser",
  "parse"
]
license.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
include.workspace = true

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["unstable-doc"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs", "--generate-link-to-definition"]
cargo-args = ["-Zunstable-options", "-Zrustdoc-scrape-examples"]

[package.metadata.playground]
features = ["unstable-doc"]

[package.metadata.release]
shared-version = true
tag-name = "v{{version}}"
pre-release-replacements = [
  {file="CHANGELOG.md", search="Unreleased", replace="{{version}}", min=1},
  {file="CHANGELOG.md", search="\\.\\.\\.HEAD", replace="...{{tag_name}}", exactly=1},
  {file="CHANGELOG.md", search="ReleaseDate", replace="{{date}}", min=1},

limitations: File changes cover captured sources of the selected entry language only. Documents, excluded files and other languages are not checked; absence here is not evidence of no change. Definitions are selected only in the entry file; references search all captured files.

Unique file + qualified name + syntax kind slots pair reading locations, not persistent entities. Renames and moves are never inferred. Function text changes, including formatting, do not prove semantic change; identical text shifted in position is reported separately.

Known references are conservative source callsites, not runtime callers or complete/transitive impact. Dynamic dispatch, unsupported member calls, constructors and tagged templates remain outside binding coverage. Unresolved calls inside source ranges can include nested closures and owned decorators/headers. Python python-lexical-v1 targets ordinary undecorated module definitions or direct from-import aliases; v2 additionally follows one unique unconditional explicit reexport. Longer/rebound/conditional chains, decorated/method targets and runtime module initialization remain unsupported. Java v1 binds bounded same-file static source candidates; v2 additionally binds explicit class-qualified public static paths to captured top-level classes; v3 additionally distinguishes different fixed arities while same-arity/varargs competition, member dispatch and inherited owners remain unresolved. Go v1 binds captured free functions; v2 additionally follows compiler-selected concrete methods, including promotion, expressions and generic instances; v3 additionally binds interface method declarations captured in source as declaration anchors, while runtime interface dispatch and function variables remain unknown under incomplete external typing. Current Go change orientation additionally lists interface-mediated candidate callsites when captured go/types method sets prove that the changed concrete method is in an interface implementation; candidates are not definite runtime callers. Captures without interface implementation edges report interfaceCandidates as unavailable rather than zero. Argument type applicability and complete compilation are not checked. Historical unrecognized models remain unavailable with unknown totals.
